NBA DFS Picks for Saturday, October 31 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Saturday, October 31 · 5 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 31, 9:51 AM ET

Victor Wembanyama (SAS) is the top-projected player on the Saturday, October 31 DraftKings main slate at 52.2 DraftKings points for $10,900. Jalen Johnson (ATL, 52.1, $9,700) and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 47.1, $10,400) are next.

Cameron Boozer (MEM) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.49 projected points per $1,000 at $7,400.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 31, 9:51 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
